name: Bitter Melon Chromium Capsules
service: OEM / ODM / Private Label Manufacturing / Custom Formulation / Custom Packaging
description: Brief Description: A convenient capsule formula made with selected botanical ingredients including bitter melon, astragalus root, notoginseng, rehmannia root, and chromium picolinate. Each capsule contains 0.45 g, with 60 capsules per bottle and a total net content of 27 g. Formula, capsule specifications, fill quantity, bottle, packaging, and labels can be customized according to private-label customer requirements. OEM/ODM and bulk supply services are available.
